'''Lanupa''', once known as '''The Demon's Rest''' or '''Battle World''', was a [[mountain|mountainou]]s neutral [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]. It was home of the [[Skull Ridge Mountain]], atop which was located the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]], formerly a fearsome pirate stronghold that boasted torturous execution acid baths and fighting pits. SM-33 was outraged at how they had "ruined it!" with visiting pleasure [[yacht]]s, spa, mud baths (fed by natural hot springs), bacta soaks and buffets ("food for weaklings!").<ref name="You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates" /> Lanupa was also the [[homeworld]] of the [[Trash crab]], a [[species]] of [[crab]] that wore pieces of technological scrap on their back.<ref name="Zero Friends Again" />

During the [[New Republic Era]], as the luxury spa did not admit children, the crew of the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'' ([[Fern]], [[Wim]], [[KB|Neel]], [[KB]], the [[droid]] [[SM-33]] and [[Neel|Jod Na Nawood]]) had to adopt new identities: the children as the "Most Wise Elders" from the Bratric System, and Jod Na Nawood as the probable [[Muun]] [[Professor]] [[Umiam Gorelox]].<ref name="You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates" />

The [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] studied [[Ur-Kittât]] [[writing]] on a wall as the [[Myykian]] [[Neel]] watched, before they discovered the abandoned [[Captain Rennod's Lair]] and found the coordinates to [[At Attin]].<ref name="You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates" />

[[Silvo's pirates|Nawood's former pirate crew]] invaded Lanupa in search of the Nawood after being tipped off by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Pokkit]].<ref name="You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates" /> They managed to capture Nawood and SM-33, before fleeing the planet as a squadron of [[New Republic]] [[X-wing starfighter]]s chased them off, resulting one of the two pirate vessels being shot down.<ref name="Zero Friends Again" />

Meanwhile, the [[Skeleton Crew]] managed to recover the ''Onyx Cinder'', but as the ship was pinned by a garbage machine, they were forced to purge the hull, allowing them to break free and depart Lanupa.<ref name="Zero Friends Again" />

{{Planet-stub}}
